text.arabic_uthmani: ٱللَّهُ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَقْدِرُ لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۭ

words.gloss_range: the named divine subject who initiates the provision action
words.root_gloss_range: deity, worship, and contested proper-name derivation; locally selected as the definite divine proper name

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: emphatic particle opening the knowledge warrant

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) opens as the explicit agent before any economic verb appears. The proper name fixes the actor as the named divine referent, while the repeated name later under {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) turns the ayah into an actor-to-knower frame. Its provision formula and the asyndetic move after 29:61 make the statement sound like a direct answer, not a loose continuation.

topics.headline: opening divine agent as answer frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins by naming the agent before the economic action, turning the prior question into a direct declarative answer.
topics.reason: The name is nominative and attached as the subject of the first provision verb; the boundary rows support an asyndetic answer after the prior interrogation.

topics.headline: proper name with narrowed derivational pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the subject is the definite divine proper name, while derivational debates remain only background pressure under the selected deity-name reading.
topics.reason: The local surface is a proper divine name and not an indefinite deity noun; the derivational dispute can color the name but cannot replace the local proper-name function.

topics.headline: opening name begins a bookend
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same divine name reappearing later under a new case role, so action and knowledge frame the whole ayah.
topics.reason: The opening nominative name and later accusative name create a visible actor-to-warrant frame, with same-surah knowledge echoes reinforcing the closure (29:60).

topics.headline: formulaic provision opening with audible join
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening participates in a familiar provision formula and is heard as a tight agent-act unit.
topics.reason: The rows connect the divine name with the expansion-provision formula, while the recitation note supports audible continuity without changing the grammar.

words.gloss_range: ongoing divine expanding or opening out of provision for a recipient
words.root_gloss_range: spreading, extending, unfolding, and opening; locally narrowed to economic expansion of provision

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: measuring or restricting provision as the counter-pole to expansion

words.prose: {{ar:يَبْسُطُ}} ({{tr:yabsuṭu}}) presents provision-expansion as an ongoing direct act. The root's spreading image survives: provision is not merely handed over but opened out as access, though the object keeps the image within the economic field. Because the verb is paired with {{ar:يَقْدِرُ}} ({{tr:yaqdiru}}), expansion becomes the first pole of a formula for total divine control over provision. After the prior interrogation (29:61), this verb begins the new declarative provision scene, and its firm final stop keeps the spreading action from sounding loose.

topics.headline: ongoing direct expansion of provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices expansion as a direct, ongoing divine act with provision as object and recipient marked separately.
topics.reason: The verb is Form I active imperfect, with an explicit direct object and a separate dative recipient phrase.

topics.headline: spreading image applied to resource access
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that provision is pictured as opened out or spread for access, while the local object keeps the image economic rather than physical.
topics.reason: The broader spreading field survives as image-pressure because the local object is provision; physical carpet-like senses are not independently active.

topics.headline: expansion pole of a provision merism
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices expansion as the first pole of a recurring expansion-restriction formula, not as one-sided prosperity theology.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence and coordination evidence tie this verb to the later restriction verb over the same provision field.

topics.headline: declarative scene shift with firm sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the boundary shift from prior interrogation into ordered provision action, with the verb's sound closing the expansion firmly.
topics.reason: The boundary rows connect 29:62 with earlier provision-seeking and prior cosmic questioning; the sound row adds local texture without altering the sense.

words.gloss_range: the definite provision domain being expanded and then implicitly restricted
words.root_gloss_range: provision, sustenance, livelihood, and beneficial resources; locally the shared object of divine allocation
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلرِّزْقَ}} ({{tr:al-rizqa}}) is the acted-upon domain: it is expanded by the first verb and then carried forward as the understood object of restriction. Its definite maṣdar form compresses the act of providing and the received share into one resource field, broader than cash or food alone. Same-surah links to seeking provision (29:17) and creature-provision (29:60) make this noun the ayah's economic pivot, and its doubled sound gives the central resource word audible density.

topics.headline: one object shared by opposite verbs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that one provision object receives both expansion and restriction, making the two verbs operate on the same domain.
topics.reason: The noun is the direct object of the first verb and is recoverable as the omitted object of the second verb.

topics.headline: definite maṣdar as total provision domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices provision as a definite life-support domain, not a narrow item such as money alone.
topics.reason: The definite singular gerundal noun packages provision as a category; the lexical rows support livelihood, sustenance, and beneficial resources.

topics.headline: providing process compressed into object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the act of providing and the thing provided are compressed into one manipulable object.
topics.reason: The local form is a gerundal noun used nominally as a direct object, not a finite provision verb or provider title.

topics.headline: provision thread from seeking to allocation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the word gathering same-surah provision material into this direct allocation statement (29:17, 29:60).
topics.reason: The rows give concrete same-surah provision links and a dominant divine-provision collocation.

topics.headline: dense sound at the economic center
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices audible weight on the central provision noun.
topics.reason: The sound row adds local texture to the already central shared object.

words.gloss_range: beneficiary or directional preposition marking the recipient for whom expansion is made

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: beneficiary preposition fused to the open relative recipient

words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) turns the following open pronoun into the beneficiary of provision-expansion. Because it comes after the provision object, the ayah first names the whole resource domain and then narrows toward the recipient. Its fusion into {{ar:لِمَن}} ({{tr:liman}}) makes recipient marking inseparable from the open selection slot.

topics.headline: beneficiary marker for expansion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that provision is expanded for a recipient, not simply expanded as an abstract quantity.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the relative pronoun as the beneficiary complement of the expansion verb.

topics.headline: bound marker fused into recipient phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices recipient selection arriving after the provision domain, with the marker fused to the open pronoun.
topics.reason: The particle is proclitic to the following relative pronoun and appears after the object, so scope is broad first and recipient selection second.

words.gloss_range: open relative pronoun marking whoever receives provision by divine selection
words.prose: {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) leaves the recipient unnamed: no tribe, merit category, or social class is supplied. The following willing clause resolves the slot, and the later singular dative can echo it, so the wording can suggest the same person experiencing both expansion and restriction while still leaving distributional ambiguity open.

topics.headline: open relative recipient slot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the recipient is not named by class or merit; the slot stays open until divine willing resolves it.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun introduces the selection clause and contributes an open human recipient rather than a lexical class label.

topics.headline: open slot narrowed by singular return
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the open recipient can be resumed by a singular pronoun, creating pressure toward the same-recipient reading while preserving ambiguity.
topics.reason: The later dative pronoun is singular and can return to this relative slot, though the grammar does not force only one referent scenario.

topics.headline: hinge between provision and servant pool
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this word as the hinge that converts general provision into selected allocation from a larger pool.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun sits between the provision object and the servant phrase, with fixed form and no inherent class marker.

words.gloss_range: operative divine willing that selects the recipient while leaving the willed object unspoken
words.root_gloss_range: willing, deciding, and thing-related root pressure; locally the verb of divine volition

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the universal thing noun that later echoes the willing root

words.prose: {{ar:يَشَآءُ}} ({{tr:yashāʾu}}) makes recipient selection depend on divine willing while leaving the object unstated: whom, how much, when, and how remain compressed. The imperfect form keeps that selection in the mode of ongoing governance, and the long vowel plus final catch makes the selection point audible before the servant pool appears. Its root echo with {{ar:شَىْءٍ}} ({{tr:shayʾin}}) later in the ayah is real but narrowed: the local word still functions as a verb of willing, while the close moves to the field of every thing known.

topics.headline: active divine selection without stated object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices divine willing as operative selection with its object compressed rather than spelled out.
topics.reason: The 3ms subject resolves to the opening divine name, and the verb appears without an explicit object in the recipient-selection frame.

topics.headline: ongoing divine-discretion formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices selection as continuing divine governance, not a one-time past allocation.
topics.reason: The imperfect form and high-frequency divine-discretion formula support an ongoing selection frame.

topics.headline: will-to-thing root echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a local root echo from willing to thinghood, while the verb itself still means willing rather than naming an object.
topics.reason: The shared root-family pressure is useful as an internal echo with the closing universal noun, but local grammar keeps this word as a verb of willing.

topics.headline: marked sound at the selection point
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the selection verb as a sounded hinge before the servant pool.
topics.reason: The spelling and hamza rows add recitational weight to the selection point without altering the parse.

topics.headline: will governs the allocation field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices willing as directly governing the expansion-restriction economy rather than floating as an isolated pious phrase.
topics.reason: The verb is direct Form I volition, and the co-occurrence rows bind it to provision expansion and restriction surfaces.

words.gloss_range: partitive preposition marking selection from within the servant pool
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) makes the following servants a pool from which recipients are selected. The ayah states divine willing first and only then gives the human field, so the boundary of the group is subordinate to selection. The particle remains visibly separate, keeping the partitive edge clear before the servant noun, while its nasal close prepares the move into that noun.

topics.headline: partitive selection from servants
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recipients are selected from among God's servants rather than all being treated as one undifferentiated allocation group.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the servant noun as a partitive complement after the willing verb.

topics.headline: pool boundary arrives after will
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the human pool boundary only after divine will has been stated.
topics.reason: The phrase follows the selection verb and remains a separate short particle before the servant noun.

topics.headline: nasal bridge into servant noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the source-pool relation prepared before the servant noun lands.
topics.reason: The sound row adds local audible binding to the partitive phrase.

words.gloss_range: His servants as the possessed pool from which provision recipients are selected
words.root_gloss_range: servitude, worship, submission, and belonging; locally the devotional-relational servant collective possessed by God
words.prose: {{ar:عِبَادِهِۦ}} ({{tr:ʿibādihī}}) closes the selection phrase by naming the pool as God's own servants. The suffix routes the group back to the opening divine name, compressing many servants into one possessed collective, so provision is distributed within a relationship of belonging. The servant root carries worshipful and devotional pressure, and it recalls the surah's worship command (29:16), but locally the word is not an imperative to serve; it is the genitive pool from which selected recipients are drawn. After the prior addressed group, the phrase also shifts the referential field into God's servant category.

topics.headline: God's servants as selected-from pool
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the open recipient is drawn from a bounded pool already related to God as His servants.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive after the partitive preposition and carries a possessive suffix resolved to the opening divine name.

topics.headline: construct plural with suffix possession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices many servants compressed into one possessed collective.
topics.reason: The construct form lacks the article because the suffix supplies definiteness and possession.

topics.headline: devotional servant pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices servant identity as relational and devotional, while the local syntax keeps the noun as a selected-from pool rather than a command to worship.
topics.reason: The root family and plural choice support worshipful relation and belonging; the local phrase remains a genitive servant-pool complement.

topics.headline: servanthood and provision linked in the surah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices provision recipients tied to the surah's worship and servanthood thread (29:16).
topics.reason: The rows connect the servant root to provision and to earlier worship-command material in the same surah.

topics.headline: referential shift into God's servants
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a shift from the prior addressed group into God's servant category, with the phrase expanding audibly after the short particle.
topics.reason: The boundary and sound rows support a local referential and auditory transition.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining the restriction verb to the expansion verb
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is small, but it makes the ayah's economic structure decisive. It joins the restriction verb to the expansion verb under the same divine subject, so the two acts form a coordinated antithesis. The second beat restarts with equal force instead of sounding like a modifier of the first.

topics.headline: coordinator joins opposite provision acts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices expansion and restriction as coordinated opposites under the same subject, not as separate disconnected claims.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the second verb with the first and the verbs form an antithetical provision pair.

topics.headline: same subject with equal counter-act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second act inherits the same divine subject while standing as an equal predicate.
topics.reason: The connector permits subject retention without repetition and marks the second verb as coordinated rather than subordinate.

topics.headline: audible restart at restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the second economic beat restart rather than blur into the first.
topics.reason: The rows combine additive joining with contrastive force and local cadence reset.

words.gloss_range: ongoing divine measuring or restricting of provision, with the prior provision object understood
words.root_gloss_range: measuring, determining, apportioning, restricting, and power; locally selected as measured restriction of provision
words.prose: {{ar:يَقْدِرُ}} ({{tr:yaqdiru}}) is not bare deprivation. It carries the earlier provision object forward and presents restriction as ongoing divine measurement. The root's measure and power fields matter: the canonical form keeps the local sense at measured constriction, while the accepted Form II reading and the same-surah power echo (29:20) make the restriction feel calibrated rather than ignorant or random. After the cosmic-control scene (29:61), the same sovereignty is specified as individual provision measurement, and the qāf-dāl cluster gives the restriction pole a clipped texture.

topics.headline: ongoing restriction over the same provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices restriction as ongoing divine governance over the same provision domain already named.
topics.reason: The imperfect verb has the same divine subject and lacks an explicit object, making the prior provision noun recoverable.

topics.headline: restriction as measured calibration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices scarcity as measured apportionment, while the standard local form keeps the reading from becoming only intensive Form II determination.
topics.reason: The q-d-r field supports measure, determination, and constriction; the accepted Form II variant exposes calibration pressure, but the canonical local form remains Form I.

topics.headline: counter-pole of expansion formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices divine control across both poles of provision, not just generosity or deprivation in isolation.
topics.reason: The verb is coordinated with expansion in a recurring provision formula, yielding a binary matched pair.

topics.headline: same-root power echo from measure to ability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same root linking measured restriction here with divine power elsewhere (29:20), while the local verb still means measuring or restricting provision.
topics.reason: The concrete same-surah echo is useful, but the local verbal frame selects provision measurement rather than the adjective of omnipotence.

topics.headline: cosmic sovereignty specified as allocation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the prior cosmic-control scene narrowing into individual provision measurement.
topics.reason: The boundary rows connect 29:61's cosmic governance to 29:62's economic calibration.

topics.headline: tight sound at the restriction point
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices form-choice pressure and a tighter sound at the restriction pole.
topics.reason: The variant and sound rows sharpen the local restriction point without replacing the standard reading.

words.gloss_range: dative preposition plus singular pronoun marking the person for whom restriction is measured

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: open relative recipient slot resumed by the singular dative pronoun

words.prose: {{ar:لَهُۥٓ}} ({{tr:lahū}}) makes the restriction recipient-centered. The singular pronoun can echo the earlier open {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}), so the same person may be imagined under both expansion and restriction, though a split recipient remains grammatically possible. Its repeated lām links both sides of the ayah as directed acts, not abstract economic states, and the compact pronoun receives a lingering landing before the warrant clause.

topics.headline: restriction directed to a recipient
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that even restriction is directed to someone, not presented as impersonal scarcity.
topics.reason: The preposition plus suffix attaches as the complement of the restriction verb.

topics.headline: same or split recipient ambiguity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the singular pronoun can point back to the open recipient slot or allow a different singular recipient.
topics.reason: The suffix agrees with the relative slot, but the local grammar does not eliminate a split-referent reading.

topics.headline: second lām echoes the first recipient marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices both expansion and restriction framed by recipient markers.
topics.reason: The repeated lām binds the two economic clauses as directed acts.

topics.headline: compact pronoun with lingering landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the recipient compressed into a pronoun just before the warrant clause.
topics.reason: The fused form narrows the open slot into a singular pronoun and the recitational prolongation gives it a landing before the closing clause.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle opening the explanatory knowledge warrant
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) pivots the ayah from what God does with provision to the knowledge that warrants it. It starts a new governed clause, assigning the repeated divine name its role and preparing the final predicate. After the expansion-restriction pair, the particle's emphasis answers the possible unease created by unequal allocation, and the doubled nasal presses the audible transition into epistemic grounding.

topics.headline: emphatic warrant for allocation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the closing clause as the reasoned warrant for unequal provision, not as a detached formula.
topics.reason: The particle opens a full emphatic clause after the coordinated provision pair.

topics.headline: particle creates new case frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a formal shift into a governed nominal clause, with the divine name and predicate assigned their roles.
topics.reason: The particle governs the following divine name and sets up the final predicate as the khabar.

topics.headline: resolution after expansion and restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the emphatic closure addressing the tension created by expansion for some and restriction for others.
topics.reason: The clause follows the completed antithetical pair and confirms the knowledge basis of distribution.

topics.headline: audible and discourse transition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the ayah pivot from economic action into epistemic grounding.
topics.reason: The transition rows connect the emphatic particle, universal scope, and final predicate into warrant logic.

words.gloss_range: the repeated divine proper name as the governed topic of the knowledge warrant
words.root_gloss_range: deity, worship, and contested proper-name derivation; locally the same definite divine proper name under emphatic governance

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: emphatic particle governing the repeated divine name

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}) repeats the opening name instead of using a pronoun. The case has changed under {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}), so the same referent moves from acting subject to the emphatically governed topic of knowledge. That repetition encloses the ayah's provision acts inside a named-agent and named-knower frame, and the particle-name liaison makes the warrant opening continuous in recitation.

topics.headline: divine name repeated before knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warrant repeats the divine name rather than using a pronoun, reanchoring knowledge to the same actor.
topics.reason: The inna-clause uses the explicit divine name as its governed noun, tying the final knowledge predicate to the opening agent.

topics.headline: same name recased under emphatic governance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same divine referent shifting from nominative actor to accusative topic of the warrant clause.
topics.reason: The repeated name changes case because the particle governs it, marking a syntactic role shift rather than simple repetition.

topics.headline: proper name retained under knowledge predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same fused divine proper name retained, while derivational dispute remains subordinate to the selected deity-name reading.
topics.reason: The local clause selects the proper divine name coupled with knowledge; derivational debate does not change the reference.

topics.headline: actor-to-knower inclusio
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices economic action enclosed by divine agency and divine knowledge.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence and bookend rows support a dominant God-knowledge association and a local actor-to-knower frame.

topics.headline: particle-name liaison
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the emphatic particle and divine name as a continuous warrant opening.
topics.reason: The recitation row adds audible continuity at the start of the closing clause.

words.gloss_range: preposition marking the scope or respect in which knowledge applies

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: preposition fused to the universal quantifier as a scope unit

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) opens the knowledge domain for the final predicate. Here it is relational and scope-extending, not a tool or place marker: knowledge is with respect to every thing. Because the clitic fuses into {{ar:بِكُلِّ}} ({{tr:bikulli}}), the universal scope is heard before the closing attribute lands.

topics.headline: preposition extends knowledge over domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the knowledge predicate taking a governed scope domain rather than standing as a vague attribute.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the universal phrase as the scope complement of the final knowledge predicate.

topics.headline: relational bāʾ, not tool or place
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices relation and scope extension, while instrumental or locative meanings are excluded by the knowledge predicate frame.
topics.reason: The local predicate licenses relation with a knowledge domain, not an instrument or location.

topics.headline: fused scope unit before predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices universal scope arriving before the final knowledge word and fused tightly to the quantifier.
topics.reason: The clitic attaches to the quantifier, and the whole prepositional phrase precedes the predicate adjective.

words.gloss_range: construct universal quantifier creating total scope over the following thing noun
words.root_gloss_range: whole, every, totality, and unrelated homograph branches; locally the universal quantifier in construct
words.prose: {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}) makes the knowledge domain total. It is the construct head of the phrase, not a loose adjective, so the following noun becomes the class over which every instance is covered. Same-radical homograph meanings are blocked here; what survives is whole-and-every totality. The familiar divine-attribute scope formula is specialized to provision allocation, and the same-surah contrast shifts universal scope from power (29:20) to knowledge (29:62).

topics.headline: totalizing every without exception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the knowledge claim ranges over every member of the class, with no residual exception outside it.
topics.reason: The quantifier creates total scope over the following indefinite noun in the knowledge phrase.

topics.headline: construct head of the universal phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word is not merely an adjective but the syntactic head that creates the universal domain.
topics.reason: The word is genitive under the preposition and governs the following noun in construct.

topics.headline: totality selected over homograph branches
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices whole-and-every totality as the selected value, while unrelated same-radical senses are blocked by the construct phrase.
topics.reason: The local construct with the following noun selects the quantifier meaning and excludes weary or blunt homograph readings.

topics.headline: recurring divine-attribute scope formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a familiar divine-attribute scope formula now specialized to knowledge of provision allocation.
topics.reason: The rows identify the phrase as a recurring scope marker and show it preparing the final predicate.

topics.headline: same-surah totality contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same-surah totality frame shifting from power to knowledge (29:20, 29:62).
topics.reason: The concrete echo contrasts the attribute chosen with the same totality phrase, while the sound row adds compressed local texture.

words.gloss_range: indefinite singular thing completing the scope of every thing under divine knowledge
words.root_gloss_range: thinghood, entity, matter, affair, and will-linked root pressure; locally the universal class noun under the quantifier

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: construct universal quantifier completed by the thing noun
earlier willing verb that shares root-echo pressure with the thing noun

words.prose: {{ar:شَىْءٍ}} ({{tr:shayʾin}}) supplies the class over which {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}) ranges. Its indefinite singular form does not shrink the scope; it lets every possible instance, entity, matter, or affair fall under the knowledge claim, each thing ranged over individually before the final attribute lands. The root echo with {{ar:يَشَآءُ}} ({{tr:yashāʾu}}) is narrowed but meaningful: the ayah moves from what God wills in allocation to every thing God knows, with the hamza giving the universal noun a small audible catch.

topics.headline: thing completes the universal domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the quantifier receives its class from an indefinite singular noun, maximizing the scope of divine knowledge.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive as the complement of the construct quantifier and remains indefinite singular.

topics.headline: scoped object of knowledge through grammar
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the specific provision case being generalized into a universal knowledge maxim.
topics.reason: The noun reaches the predicate through the preposition and quantifier, turning the final clause into a tail generalization.

topics.headline: actual and conceivable thinghood
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the knowledge domain covering actual entities and conceivable affairs, not a closed list.
topics.reason: The lexical rows and tanwīn support maximal openness under the universal quantifier.

topics.headline: root return from willing to thing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the earlier willing root returning as the noun for thing, while local grammar keeps this word as the universal object class.
topics.reason: The root link is a useful internal echo with the earlier verb, but it does not make this noun itself a verb of willing.

topics.headline: singular thing with audible catch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices each thing individually ranged over before the final attribute lands.
topics.reason: The singular form supports distributive coverage under the quantifier, and the hamza marks the noun audibly before the final predicate.

words.gloss_range: stable, intensive knowledge predicate closing the ayah after universal scope
words.root_gloss_range: knowledge, certainty, teaching, learning, and knowing forms; locally the faʿīl attribute of complete divine knowledge
words.prose: {{ar:عَلِيمٌۭ}} ({{tr:ʿalīmun}}) is the final predicate and final word. It lands only after the universal scope has been stated, so the ayah closes on complete knowledge rather than on wealth, will, or restriction. The faʿīl form presents stable certain knowing, not acquired learning, and the same-surah contrast with power (29:20) makes knowledge the chosen warrant for the allocation pattern. As a recurring universal-knowledge seal, it bookends the opening divine agency and gives the final tanwīn cadence qualitative weight.

topics.headline: final predicate after universal scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah ending not on wealth or scarcity but on the knowledge predicate after its scope has already been expanded.
topics.reason: The adjective is the khabar of the emphatic clause and comes after the universal prepositional scope phrase.

topics.headline: stable certain knowledge attribute
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices knowledge as stable and certain possession, not acquired learning or conjecture.
topics.reason: The faʿīl adjective and knowledge-root rows support inherent, durable, certain knowing while excluding teaching or learning senses in this local closure.

topics.headline: knowledge chosen as the allocation warrant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah grounding provision differences in knowledge rather than closing with power or wisdom language.
topics.reason: The same-surah contrast with universal power (29:20) and the tadhyīl rows make knowledge the chosen warrant for allocation.

topics.headline: recurring universal knowledge seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a recognized universal-knowledge formula specifically sealing this provision statement.
topics.reason: The recurring formula rows show the phrase as a standard divine knowledge seal, locally applied to expansion and restriction.

topics.headline: faʿīl form selected over neighboring forms
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the chosen adjective form as durable quality rather than a simple active participle or hyper-intensive alternative.
topics.reason: The form rows contrast the selected adjective with nearby knowledge-family forms without importing those forms into the local surface.

topics.headline: agency-knowledge bookend and audible closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the whole ayah framed by divine agency at the start and knowledge at the final sound.
topics.reason: The bookend and cadence rows support the closing word as the semantic and audible seal, with same-surah knowledge echoes (29:60).

topics.headline: indefinite predicate carries qualitative weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final attribute as a weighty qualitative seal tied to the universal object before it.
topics.reason: The tanwīn, specialized adjective closure, and ring-frame rows add local form and sound weight to the final predicate.

baseline_models.mechanism: The breadth and increase of بسط oppose the deliberate reduction of قدر, while رزق names a divided allotment. The pair depicts active resizing of an assigned benefit rather than two unrelated outcomes.

activation_trace.role: Breadth, increase, and surplus make بسط the widening pole of the allocation mechanism.
Reduction to a small measure makes قدر the narrowing pole opposed to expansion.
A divided gift or benefit supplies the object whose accessible measure is widened or narrowed.

changed_reading.before: God gives some recipients more provision and others less.
changed_reading.after: God actively opens an allotted field of benefit or narrows it to a measured span for a recipient.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لِمَن يَشَآءُ ... إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
baseline_models.mechanism: The مشيئة branch binds willing to a thing, كل encloses all parts, and علم presents apprehended disclosure. The allocation is object-specific and exhaustively known, not an impersonal fluctuation.

activation_trace.role: Volition related to a thing links the chosen recipient and the concluding 'thing' under one intentional frame.
Enclosure and totality make the final knowledge claim comprehensive rather than generic.
Known disclosure supplies the epistemic ground surrounding each differential measure.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports unrestricted sovereign choice.
changed_reading.after: Each widening or narrowing is presented as a particular willing enclosed by exhaustive knowledge of every relevant thing.

baseline_models.mechanism: عباد activates obedient service, the divine name activates the worshipped source, and رزق remains an assigned gift. Distribution therefore occurs inside a worship relation, not as an anonymous transfer between detached economic actors.

activation_trace.role: Submissive worship makes the recipients servants whose relation to the giver matters alongside quantity.
The worshipped one frames both the opening action and the closing knowledge claim as one source's governance.
The allotted gift is the material term carried inside that servant-source relation.

changed_reading.before: People are recipients of unequal amounts.
changed_reading.after: Widening and narrowing are relational acts toward servants of the one worshipped, not anonymous movements of wealth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's opening repeatedly casts human conditions as an assay that makes truthfulness and falsehood knowable. Read back into the focus, expanded and restricted provision can be distinct testing conditions under the closing علم clause, rather than transparent rewards and punishments.

activation_trace.role: Testing metal or a person supplies the assay image for conditions that expose a response.
The repeated assay establishes testing as a sustained surah-level mechanism rather than an isolated hardship.
Disclosure to knowledge links the assay to the focus verse's concluding omniscience.

structural_cues: 29:2-3 place repeated testing before a paired disclosure of the truthful and the false, while 29:62 closes differential provision with علم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assay, differentiated responses, and knowledge; I infer that breadth and restriction may function as differing assay conditions. A live alternative is that testing governs the surah generally while 29:62 only describes provision.

changed_reading.before: Breadth signals favor and restriction signals disfavor.
changed_reading.after: Either breadth or restriction may be an assay condition whose significance lies partly in the servant's disclosed response, so quantity alone does not reveal moral rank.

context_deltas.mechanism: 29:17 denies other worshipped objects any ownership or disposal of provision, then directs seeking, worship, and gratitude to God. This sharpens 29:62 into source discrimination: changing amounts never transfer providential authority to a rival source.

activation_trace.role: Ownership and power of disposal are explicitly denied to alternative objects of worship, isolating the true source.
The allotted gift appears first as what rivals cannot control and then as what must be sought with God.
Active seeking gives the recipient a role without converting effort into ultimate ownership of the outcome.
Recognition of the benefit and its giver supplies the response appropriate to provision.
Repeated worship and obedience connect the focus's 'His servants' to allegiance toward the provider.

structural_cues: 29:17 repeats provision inside a denial-command sequence: rivals do not own it; seek it with God; worship Him; give thanks.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied rival ownership and commanded seeking, worship, and thanks; I infer that 29:62 stabilizes allegiance across changing amounts. Alternatively, 29:17 may polemicize idolatry without specifying why individual shares differ.

changed_reading.before: Differential provision is simply a fact about unequal shares.
changed_reading.after: Whatever the share, provision tests recognition of its source: neither abundance nor scarcity licenses a competing master, and seeking remains paired with worship and thanks.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same servant root appears where God's earth is declared wide and worship is commanded; patience and reliance then precede the provision sequence. This spatializes بسط: an apparently narrow channel in one place need not exhaust the wider field through which provision may open.

activation_trace.role: Servanthood and worship identify the mobile addressees as the same relational class named in the focus.
Spatial openness contrary to constriction supplies a geographic analogue for the focus's expansion.
Holding oneself from panic supplies the posture needed while a current channel remains narrow.
Reliance supplies the relational means of moving without treating stored resources as the sole guarantor.

structural_cues: 29:56 joins servants, a wide earth, and worship; 29:59 places patience and reliance immediately before the creature-provision example and 29:62.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wide earth, servants, patience, and reliance; I infer that relocation can mediate an opening of provision. The live alternative is that expansion occurs independently of movement and the wide-earth cue concerns worship alone.

changed_reading.before: The recipient passively waits within a fixed local allotment.
changed_reading.after: A locally restricted channel need not mean provision is closed altogether; for servants able to move across a wide earth, reliance and movement may participate in its opening.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding creature example negates carrying provision while affirming repeated divine provisioning and knowledge. This converts رزق from stock owned in reserve into a renewed relation of access; بسط and قدر can regulate flow without implying abandonment when inventory is absent.

activation_trace.role: Literal lifting or carrying of a visible load is negated, removing stored possession as the necessary form of security.
The allotted benefit is both named and actively supplied, turning a noun-like stock into a continuing giver-recipient relation.
Knowledge closes the non-carrying example and directly anticipates the focus's epistemic assurance.

structural_cues: 29:60 says a creature does not carry its provision, then places 'God provides it and you' beside hearing and knowing immediately before 29:62.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-carriage, active provisioning, and knowledge; I infer recurring access rather than possessed inventory. A narrower alternative is that the example only observes that many creatures do not store food.

changed_reading.before: Expansion and restriction describe how much provision a recipient possesses.
changed_reading.after: They can describe the width of an ongoing supply relation: provision may arrive without being carried or stored, and a narrowed flow is not the same as absence of care.

context_deltas.mechanism: The رزق inventory itself contains rain as provision, and the next ayah realizes a chain of descent, conveyed water, and revived earth. Expansion thus becomes ecological throughput that propagates life, while restriction can be read as reduced throughput rather than only a smaller cash-like quantity.

activation_trace.role: Rain descending as provision supplies the focus-side latent bridge from allotment to hydrology.
Bringing down and conveying supplies the delivery stage of the provision mechanism.
Water delivered by pouring or irrigation supplies the mobile medium through which benefit spreads.
Earth's life through rain and vegetation supplies the conversion of delivered provision into living productivity.

structural_cues: 29:63 follows the focus immediately and forms a causal-looking sequence from descent to water to earth revived after death.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rain-provision, delivered water, and revived earth; I supply the throughput arrow linking those stages to بسط. The alternative is that 29:63 exemplifies divine power and gratitude without defining the expansion-restriction pair.

changed_reading.before: Provision is a static amount of money or food assigned to an individual.
changed_reading.after: Provision can be a transmitted life process: water descends, spreads through earth, and becomes renewed productivity, so expansion names reach and conversion as well as quantity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel calls present life distraction and unserious play, then calls what was given an enjoyed benefit followed by future knowing. This blocks reading broad provision as permanent ownership or final valuation; it is usable but temporally bounded.

activation_trace.role: Being occupied away from what matters marks worldly use as capable of diverting attention from ultimate value.
Action without a serious final aim prevents present abundance from serving as the final score.
The unrealized human knowing contrasts with the focus's already exhaustive divine knowledge.
A benefit that is enjoyed supplies a usufruct image: real use without a claim of permanent possession or rank.

structural_cues: 29:64 contrasts present life with the enduring life, and 29:66 places enjoyment of what was given before future knowing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies diversion, play, enjoyed benefit, and delayed human knowing; I infer that expanded provision is temporary use rather than final valuation. Alternatively, the warning may concern misuse of provision rather than its tenure.

changed_reading.before: Expanded provision is a durable gain and evidence of settled favor.
changed_reading.after: Expanded provision is a temporally bounded benefit for use; its abundance does not settle ultimate life, ownership, or moral standing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the rare livestock branch of بسط beside a crawling creature and negated carrying, rather than using the ordinary wealth sense. It remains anchored to the focus verb and the adjacent animal-provision example. Render it only as an exploratory access analogy, not as a replacement translation of يَبْسُطُ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ, activated beside 29:60's creature that does not carry provision

activation_trace.role: The she-camel left unrestricted with her young contributes a literal release-from-restraint image and makes unblocked access the proposed mode of expansion.
A creature creeping on earth supplies the adjacent animal ecology that activates the livestock image.
Negated carrying of a visible load shifts security away from stock and toward access while moving.
Contraction to a small measure supplies the counterpole against which released access counts as expansion.

changed_reading.before: To expand provision is only to increase the recipient's stock.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, expansion may also mean removing restraints and opening access, as when a dependent creature is left free to reach what sustains it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the cooking-vessel sense of قدر is not the ordinary constriction sense required by the syntax. It remains visibly anchored to يَقْدِرُ and food-like رزق and preserves a material analogy for measured allotment. Downstream prose should label it a pot-and-portion image, never a lexical gloss.

activation_trace.role: The cooking pot contributes a bounded vessel in which an undifferentiated supply becomes a prepared portion.
Food entering the body supplies the material content portioned by the vessel analogy.

changed_reading.before: Restriction is an abstract reduction in amount.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, provision is portioned through a finite vessel: what reaches a servant is measured and prepared, not merely subtracted from an unlimited pile.

strongest_changes: Provision shifted from possessed stock to a renewed flow that need not be carried.
Expansion and restriction became possible assay conditions rather than readable badges of moral rank.
Wide earth and reliance made provision spatially mobile, while the rain sequence made it ecological throughput.
Worldly abundance became temporary usable benefit rather than permanent ownership or final valuation.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context linked the focus's metering verbs to testing, worship, migration, animal dependence, hydrology, and temporality without collapsing those mechanisms into one reading. The rare released-camel branch preserved an access-not-volume possibility.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not state that relocation causes expansion; that directional link remains abductive.
The testing frame may govern servant response generally rather than explain each differential allotment.
The livestock-release and cooking-vessel images are branch-distant analogies, not proposed lexical substitutions.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Provision as expansion and measured constriction.** ب س ط B001 is spreading and extending opposite constriction, and B003 is spacious increase and ample capacity. The verb is paired with يقدر, while knowledge closes over both conditions. I infer that expansion and restriction are calibrated modes of one provisioning governance; abundance reads as opened space rather than ownership, and constriction as measure rather than absence of knowledge.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 29:63's rain makes “spreading provision” materially visible as water opens dead earth into life. Expansion can therefore be ecological and regenerative, not only quantitative wealth.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Provision is deliberately modulated between spread and narrow measure.** Lexical evidence: `يَبْسُط`, root `ب س ط`, `B001` (spreading and extending opposite constriction); `ٱلرِّزْق`, root `ر ز ق`, `B001` (allotted gift); `يَشَاء`, root `ش ي ء`, packet `B001` in its accepted willing variant; and `يَقْدِر`, root `ق د ر`, `B004` (narrowing to a scant measure). Structural cue: opposed verbs share the same provider and beneficiary relation; `29:60` denied creaturely self-carrying, and `29:63` displays rain expanding dead land into life. Assigned role: spreading and narrowing are two controlled settings of one allocation system; willing is the governing hinge. Abductive move: the packet states both operations but not their local reasons; I infer deliberate modulation, not that abundance always signals favor or scarcity rejection. Reading change: unequal provision reads as measured distribution under one knower rather than competition among providers.

2. **Servanthood remains stable across changing quantity.** Lexical evidence: `عِبَادِه`, root `ع ب د`, `B003` (worship and submissive obedience); `كُل`, root `ك ل ل`, `B003` (totality); and `عَلِيم`, root `ع ل م`, `B001` (knowing as clear). Structural cue: beneficiaries remain “His servants” under both expansion and constriction, and total knowledge closes the ayah. Assigned role: servanthood fixes the relation; quantity varies inside comprehensive knowledge. Abductive move: I infer that provision level does not redefine ownership or worship-worthiness. Reading change: economic variation is prevented from becoming a theological reassignment.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - **Later correction (`29:66-67`):** Rescue-benefit and protected security are enjoyed while their source is covered. These scenes prevent provision's spread or constriction from serving as a simple index of allegiance: recipients can inhabit favor and still redirect trust, so quantity never settles the theological relation.

inter_ayah_rows.note: Provision sent down from the sky is an explicit sign of divine life-giving governance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Provision is located with heaven and its Lord, directly relocating its source beyond human control.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: God needs no provision from creatures, decisively distinguishing the self-sufficient provider from recipients.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: God is explicitly named the Provider and possessor of enduring power.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: God alone enriches and suffices, providing a compact parallel to expanding provision.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: People are made successors over what God has entrusted to them, denying absolute ownership of wealth.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Seeking God’s bounty after prayer frames livelihood as pursued within dependence on Him.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Wealth and children as a test help prevent reading abundance as uncomplicated favor.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its promise of a way out for God-conscious people supplies the immediate trust context for unexpected provision in 65:3.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: People are directed to travel, eat from God’s provision, and remember their return to Him.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The rhetorical question of who can provide if God withholds provision directly states His final control over it.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Rain, wealth, and children are described as divine increase, offering a concrete expansion pattern.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Abundant water is given as a test, sharply separating increased provision from guaranteed approval.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The human inference that generous provision proves honor directly challenges status-based readings of abundance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The companion inference that restricted provision proves humiliation is explicitly rejected by its immediate contrast.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Sustenance depends on apportioned expansion and reliable custody, not on a creature's ability to carry and secure its own future.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Dependence becomes freight, surety, agency, crawling motion, spread cloth, extended hand, and exact metering.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tapınma eylemini, kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini, bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı ve tapınılan varlığı aynı anlam örgüsü içinde açıkça birleştirir. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ondan türeyen varlık adlarını doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, tapınma eylemi ile bundan türeyen tapınılan veya tapınılır kılınan varlık anlamlarını kapsar; şaşkınlık, yoğun üzüntü ve salt özel ad kullanımları bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eylem çekirdeğini türemiş eylem ve varlık adlarından ayırır; türemiş biçimlerin kapsamı yalın eylemin tamamına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, tapınmayı anlamın temeli sayar; kişinin tapınmaya yönelmesini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılma işlemini bu temelden türetir. Tapınma konusu sayılan yontular ve güneş örneği, varlık anlamının belirli uygulamalarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Eylem çekirdeğiyle ondan türeyen tapınılan varlık anlamının birlikte temsil edilmesi gereken genel açıklamalarda kullanılır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أله وتأله بمعنى عبد وتنسك، والتأليه بمعنى التعبيد، والإله والآلهة والإلاهة لما جعل معبودا.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه أله بمعنى تحير، ولا ألهت على فلان بمعنى اشتد جزعي عليه، ولا أسماء المواضع أو الحية أو الهلال إلا من جهة التسمية لا معنى العبادة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو التعبد، فالإله الله تعالى لأنه معبود، وتأله الرجل إذا تعبد، والإلاهة الشمس سميت بذلك لأن قوما كانوا يعبدونها (maqayis)؛ التأله التعبد (ayn)؛ أله بالفتح إلاهة أي عبد عبادة، مألوه أي معبود، الآلهة الأصنام، التأليه التعبيد، التأله التنسك والتعبد (sihah)؛ لا يكون إلاها حتى يكون معبودا، معبوداتهم من الأصنام والأوثان آلهة، الإلاهة الشمس، وإلاهتك وعبادتك (tahdhib)؛ إله اسما لكل معبود، أله فلان يأله الآلهة عبد، فالإله على هذا هو المعبود (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini, genel tapınılan-varlık adından türetiliş açıklamasını ve bu özel adla kurulan seslenme ile ant biçimlerini birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak dal yalnızca seslenme ve ant kalıpları değildir; özel adın yalın kullanımı da çekirdekte tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, özel ad ile bu ada bağlı seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimleriyle sınırlıdır; herhangi bir tapınılan varlığı gösteren genel ad anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın özel ad, doğrudan seslenme biçimleri ve ant ya da şaşma kalıpları ayrı tutulur; kalıplara özgü işlevler özel adın her kullanımına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini ve bu adla kurulan seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimlerini kapsar. Bu biçimler doğrudan seslenme, adın ant değeriyle kullanılması veya ses ve parçaların düşürülmesiyle kısaltılma yollarını gösterir.

facets.statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
Özel adın, tapınılan varlığı bildiren genel addan ses düşmesi ve belirleyici unsur eklenmesiyle oluştuğu açıklanır.
Özel ad, sözün başında ant değeri taşıyarak ardından gelen yapmama bildirimini güçlendirebilir.
Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.
Ses veya parçaların düşürüldüğü kısalmış biçimler, şaşma ve ant anlatan kalıplarda kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar özel adı Yaratıcıya özgü bir ad olarak tanımlar ve onu tapınılan varlığı gösteren genel adla köken bakımından ilişkilendirir. Aynı adın doğrudan seslenmede, yakarmada, ant bildiriminde ve parçaları düşürülmüş kalıplarda kullanıldığı birlikte gösterilir.
